def.short: a round place where roads meet and cars drive around it
def.long: A round area where several roads meet. Cars drive around it in one direction and then turn onto the road they want. Americans often say 'traffic circle'.

examples.en: Take the second exit at the roundabout.
examples.tr: Dönel kavşakta ikinci çıkıştan çıkın.

examples.en: There is a small roundabout near my house.
examples.tr: Evimin yakınında küçük bir dönel kavşak var.

examples.en: In the UK, drivers go around a roundabout clockwise.
examples.tr: İngiltere'de sürücüler dönel kavşakta saat yönünde döner.

tr.note: Günlük Türkçede çoğu kişi sadece 'kavşak' der. İngilizcede düz kavşak 'junction' veya 'intersection', daire şeklinde olan ise 'roundabout' olur.

quiz.cloze: Go straight and turn right at the ______.

def.short: a person who travels in a car, bus, train, or plane but does not drive it
def.long: A person who travels in a car, bus, train, plane, or ship but is not the driver or one of the workers. The word is also used for taxis.

examples.en: The bus was full of passengers.
examples.tr: Otobüs yolcularla doluydu.

examples.en: Passengers must show their tickets at the gate.
examples.tr: Yolcuların kapıda biletlerini göstermesi gerekir.

examples.en: I sat in the passenger seat while my brother drove.
examples.tr: Kardeşim araba sürerken ben ön koltukta oturdum.

tr.note: 'Passenger' aracı kullanmayan kişidir. Gezmek için seyahat eden kişi ise 'traveler' veya 'tourist' olur. 'Passenger seat' ön yolcu koltuğudur.

quiz.cloze: Please wait for all ______ to get off the train first.

def.short: a wide main road where cars can drive fast between cities
def.long: A wide, fast road that connects cities and towns, often with several lanes. In the UK, people usually say 'motorway'.

examples.en: The highway is closed because of an accident.
examples.tr: Otoyol bir kaza yüzünden kapalı.

examples.en: We drove along the highway for three hours.
examples.tr: Üç saat otoyolda gittik.

examples.en: Take the next exit off the highway.
examples.tr: Otoyoldan bir sonraki çıkıştan çıkın.

tr.note: ABD'de 'highway', İngiltere'de 'motorway' denir. Her 'highway' otoyol olmayabilir; bazen sadece büyük bir ana yoldur.

quiz.cloze: Cars can drive very fast on the ______ between the two cities.

def.short: a part of a town where people live, with its own streets and shops
def.long: A small area of a town or city, and the people who live there. People often say 'my neighborhood' for the streets near their home.

examples.en: It's a quiet neighborhood with a lot of trees.
examples.tr: Ağaçları bol, sakin bir mahalle.

examples.en: Is there a pharmacy in this neighborhood?
examples.tr: Bu mahallede eczane var mı?

examples.en: Our neighborhood has a small market every Saturday.
examples.tr: Mahallemizde her cumartesi küçük bir pazar kurulur.

etymology.text: 'Neighbor' comes from Old English 'neah' (near) + 'gebur' (dweller): a 'near dweller'. '-hood' marks a state or a group, as in 'childhood'.

tr.note: İngiltere'de yazılışı 'neighbourhood'. Türkçede 'mahalle' resmî bir bölüm, 'semt' ise bir bölge hissidir; İngilizcede ikisi için de 'neighborhood' denir.

quiz.cloze: I know most people in my ______ because I have lived here for ten years.

entries.sense_note: to or in the city center

def.short: to or in the main business and shopping area of a city
def.long: To or in the busiest part of a city, where the main shops, offices, and restaurants are. It is mostly American English; British English says 'town centre' or 'city centre'.

examples.en: I'm going downtown to buy a new phone.
examples.tr: Yeni bir telefon almak için şehir merkezine gidiyorum.

examples.en: Parking downtown is very expensive.
examples.tr: Şehir merkezinde park etmek çok pahalı.

examples.en: She works downtown, near the train station.
examples.tr: Şehir merkezinde, tren istasyonunun yakınında çalışıyor.

tr.note: Daha çok ABD İngilizcesidir; İngiltere'de 'town centre' veya 'city centre' denir. 'Downtown' yön bildirdiği için önüne 'to' gelmez.

mistakes.why: Türkçedeki '-e' eki yüzünden 'to' eklenir, ama 'downtown' zaten 'şehir merkezine' demektir; 'to' gerekmez.

quiz.cloze: The main shops and offices are ______, near the central square.

def.short: with too many people in one place
def.long: Full of people, with very little free space. Buses, markets, and beaches can be like this in summer or at rush hour.

examples.en: The bus was so crowded that I had to stand.
examples.tr: Otobüs o kadar kalabalıktı ki ayakta durmak zorunda kaldım.

examples.en: I don't like crowded places.
examples.tr: Kalabalık yerleri sevmem.

examples.en: The market is very crowded on Saturdays.
examples.tr: Pazar cumartesi günleri çok kalabalık olur.

tr.note: Türkçede 'kalabalık' hem sıfat hem isimdir. İngilizcede sıfat 'crowded', isim 'crowd' olur.

mistakes.wrong: The beach was very crowd today.
mistakes.right: The beach was very crowded today.
mistakes.why: 'Kalabalık' sıfat olarak kullanılacaksa 'crowded' denir; 'crowd' isimdir (kalabalık = bir grup insan).

quiz.cloze: The bus was so ______ that I could not find a seat.

entries.sense_note: how to get to a place

def.short: words or a map that show you the way to a place
def.long: Words or a map that show you how to get to a place. You ask for them when you are lost, and you usually say the plural form.

examples.en: Excuse me, can you give me directions to the station?
examples.tr: Affedersiniz, istasyona giden yolu tarif eder misiniz?

examples.en: I asked a man in the street for directions.
examples.tr: Sokakta bir adama yolu sordum.

examples.en: My phone gave me wrong directions, so we got lost.
examples.tr: Telefonum bize yanlış yol tarifi verdi, o yüzden kaybolduk.

tr.note: Türkçede 'yol sormak' ve 'yol tarif etmek' denir. İngilizcede 'directions' çoğul kullanılır: ask for directions. Tek 'direction' ise 'yön' demektir.

mistakes.wrong: Can you tell me the direction to the station?
mistakes.right: Can you give me directions to the station?
mistakes.why: Yol tarifi için çoğul 'directions' kullanılır; tekil 'direction' sadece yön (sağ, sol, kuzey) bildirir.

quiz.cloze: I'm lost. Can I ask you for ______ to the museum?

def.short: a report that says what the weather will be like in the next days
def.long: A report that says what the weather will probably be like in the next hours or days. You can check one on TV or on your phone before you go out.

examples.en: The forecast says it will rain tomorrow.
examples.tr: Hava durumuna göre yarın yağmur yağacak.

examples.en: Did you check the weather forecast before you left?
examples.tr: Çıkmadan önce hava durumuna baktın mı?

examples.en: According to the forecast, it will be sunny all week.
examples.tr: Tahmine göre bütün hafta hava güneşli olacak.

tr.note: Türkçede 'hava durumu' denir; İngilizcede bu 'weather forecast' veya kısaca 'the forecast'tır. 'Forecast' aslında 'tahmin' demektir ve hava dışında da kullanılır.

quiz.cloze: The weather ______ says it will be sunny on Sunday.

def.micro: how hot or cold it is
def.short: a number that shows how hot or cold the air or a room is
def.long: A number that shows how hot or cold something is, for example the air, the water, or a room. We measure it in degrees.

examples.en: What's the temperature outside?
examples.tr: Dışarıda hava kaç derece?

examples.en: The temperature will drop to five degrees tonight.
examples.tr: Sıcaklık bu gece beş dereceye düşecek.

examples.en: Set the room temperature to twenty-two degrees.
examples.tr: Oda sıcaklığını yirmi iki dereceye ayarla.

tr.note: Hasta biri için 'have a temperature' = 'ateşi olmak' demektir. Hava ve oda için 'sıcaklık', hasta için 'ateş' denir.

mistakes.wrong: How many degrees is it outside?
mistakes.why: Türkçede 'kaç derece?' diye sorarız. İngilizcede doğal soru 'What's the temperature?' sorusudur.

quiz.cloze: The ______ is minus five today, so wear a warm coat.

def.short: a period of very strong wind, heavy rain, or snow
def.long: A period of very bad weather with strong wind and heavy rain, snow, or thunder. It can last for hours and often causes problems for travel.

examples.en: A big storm is coming tonight.
examples.tr: Bu gece büyük bir fırtına geliyor.

examples.en: The storm knocked down several trees in our street.
examples.tr: Fırtına sokağımızdaki birkaç ağacı devirdi.

examples.en: All flights were delayed because of the storm.
examples.tr: Fırtına yüzünden bütün uçuşlar gecikti.

tr.note: 'Storm' yağmurlu, rüzgârlı veya gök gürültülü her türlü şiddetli hava olabilir. Hortum 'tornado', kasırga 'hurricane' ile söylenir.

quiz.cloze: A big ______ is coming, so stay at home tonight.
